scenes.heading: Generating your first leads without a big ad budget

sents.d: Generating your first leads without a big ad budget
Your existing network is usually the highest-converting early lead source.

New agents often assume they need expensive lead-generation services immediately, but a well-executed outreach to your existing personal and professional network (your 'sphere of influence') is typically the highest-converting early lead source.
Consistently letting your network know you're now an agent — not just once, but through ongoing visible activity — keeps you top of mind for when someone in your network does need real estate help.
Open houses, even for listings that aren't yours (held for another agent), can be a low-cost way for new agents to meet potential buyer leads directly while building experience.

take: Work your existing network before paying for leads.
